name: Harukawa Jin
source:
[b]Hearing the Voices of the Dead・A Detective[/b]

A private detective based in Shinjuku.

Although he possesses the ability that others do not, he was nothing more than a normal detective. In an unexpected turn of events, he was targeted by a serial killer and almost lost his life, at that time, he met [url=/c166954]Azrael, the Angel of Death[/url].

Triggered by this incident, he now faces a world teeming with supernatural killers and inhuman monsters.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1364175/]Getchu[/url]]
